conclusion: Common Polyline3 simplification now preserves small closed contours that would collapse to a line or stationary move. Organic independent support planning retains a printable bed layer below nearby exact top contacts by lowering only the support first layer within its minimum height limit. No device identity or profile override selects these fixes. All 80 planning combinations, 18 small-contour combinations, 6 synthetic thin-bed slices, affected support/extrusion regressions and the supplied X2/Vulcan600/X600HD CLI cases pass. X2 Z=246.4 has 3 deposition moves; fresh Vulcan600/X600HD first support is Z=0.2375 with deposition, then exact contact Z=0.2875. Original Vulcan effective configuration including gap 0.2125 is unchanged. Known legacy preset lookup warnings remain. Installed binaries and live configuration are unchanged; this is source and disposable Release-build validation, not installation or physical printer qualification.
